value.body: A farm machinery engineer works on tractors, harvesters, sprayers and other farm equipment. Tractor and implement manufacturers and their suppliers hire them. A day may involve field trials, design and testing work, or supporting dealers and farmers with service problems.

items.label: Common tools
items.value: CAD software, field test rigs, data loggers

items.label: Work pattern
items.value: Field trials and travel to dealers are common

items.label: UG enrolment, Agriculture Engineering

items.label: UG pass-outs, Agriculture Engineering

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join a tractor or farm-equipment maker as a graduate engineer trainee in testing, product development or service, through campus placement or direct application.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: product engineer, test lead, service or product manager.
Mechanical engineers compete for the same roles.
Field work is seasonal and tied to crop cycles.
